name: qa_cpu_dense
title: OS-DENSE: the 1.0 CPU target on the dense reference project, Dense10 (6 Modern + 2 Amiga sampler voices, TB-303, FM) or Dense8 (4 Modern + 2 Amiga, TB-303, FM), delay and reverb sends on: opened from File, `cpu reset`, Play, 24 reads of `cpu` 2.5 s apart over 60 s. ASSERTS underrun 0 and guard shed 0 at every read; the mean (target 85 % of the block, 221,952 cycles) is reported, not asserted. The project must be on the card first (`o3pj_tool gen dense10` or `dense8`)

steps.say: OS-DENSE: the 1.0 CPU reference candidates of cpu-budget.md section 4: Dense10 (6 Modern + 2 Amiga sampler voices, TB-303, FM = 10 tracks) and Dense8 (4 Modern + 2 Amiga, TB-303, FM = 8 tracks), both with the delay and reverb sends on and the typical per-voice FX. BEFORE the run: build the song (`o3pj_tool gen dense10 <dir>/Dense10/project.o3pj` or `gen dense8 <dir>/Dense8/project.o3pj`, with the folder <dir>/<name>/samples made first) and copy that folder into Projects/ on the card (only one of the two on the card per run). Use the release image.
